$comment: Copilot models the live model list does not show to the account that runs the drift check (#393).
listModels() is filtered by the signed-in account's Copilot plan and policy, so a model missing from it is not evidence that Copilot stopped serving it.
An entry turns 'a default is missing from the live list' from drift into a note. Add one only with evidence: say what you checked and when.
A model leaves the pricing snapshot only when its retirement is announced in pforge-mcp/model-retirements.json and the date has passed; do not list a retired model here.
For an authoritative weekly check, give the Model Drift workflow a COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN from a plan that has the premium models.

claude-opus-5.5.detail: GitHub's changelog of 2026-09-22 offers it to Copilot Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise only; copilot --model claude-opus-5.5 is rejected as not available on an account without them, and no retirement is announced

gpt-6-astra.detail: GitHub's changelog of 2026-09-04 offers it to Copilot Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise only; copilot --model gpt-6-astra is rejected as not available on an account without them, and no retirement is announced

gemini-3.8-flash.detail: copilot --model gemini-3.8-flash answers on the account whose listModels() omits it, so the list is incomplete here, not the model retired
